about.description: StraitsX issues a fiat-backed stablecoin maintained at parity with its reference currency through reserve backing and redemption mechanisms. It enables fast, low-cost settlement of stablecoin transactions.
about.registryInfo: StraitsX (operated by Xfers Pte Ltd., Singapore; subsidiary of Fazz Financial Group, MAS-licensed Major Payment Institution). Issuer of XSGD (Singapore Dollar stablecoin) and XUSD (USD stablecoin) on Ethereum, Polygon, Zilliqa, Avalanche. Singapore Monetary Authority supervision since 2020.

fees.revenueNotes: StraitsX (XSGD, XUSD) personal-account bank transfers in/out FREE. Mint fee = blockchain network fee only (with cap, e.g. 30 XSGD on Ethereum). Inbound on-chain XSGD/USDC >=10 token: 0.5 token per transaction (business). Outbound: network fee only. USD transfers: $40 flat. Redemption via bank transfer in 5 business days. Primary protocol revenue is float income on reserves (MAS-regulated Stored Value Facility under Singapore PSA). Source: https://support.straitsx.com/support/solutions/articles/157000365666-transaction-fees-and-limits-for-straitsx-mint
